newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB details railcar unloads at export position.
newsitem.headline: CWB details railcar unloads at export position.

text.p: The number of railcars carrying grains and oilseeds unloaded at Vancouver and Thunder Bay fell below targetted levels in the week ended Aug 3 but exceeded targets in Prince Rupert, the Canadian Wheat Board said.
Vancouver unloaded 3,135 railcars versus the 3,300 target. Prince Rupert unloaded 1,102 railcars versus the 900 target. Thunder Bay unloaded 3,158 railcars versus the 3,550 target.
